description: Requires sign-in. Find accommodation operators near a set of coordinates that can be booked in real time, with live inventory from our booking partner. This differs from search_campsites, which searches the full Camping Australia directory, including places that cannot be booked online. Returns each operator's operator_id, name, town, state, distance and from-price; operator_id is the input to bk_operator_availability and bk_cart_add.
name: bk_search_operators
title: Search bookable caravan parks
